size_note: 139 x 45 x 26 mm (GSMArena; gsmchoice 139 x 45.5 x 26.5 mm). The CD5 is the CMD-C1's dual-band successor in the same shell with an outside antenna (mobile-review). A straight-on photo of the CD5 (via Koks) shows the front face 3.2 times as long as wide, as does the C1's: 43.4 x 139 mm; the 45 mm counts the jog dial standing out of the left side. The antenna stands 12 mm above the body (layout_mm.parts). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD window measures about 29 x 11 mm; 1.16in at the native 97 x 32

screen.note: w/h from the diagonal at the native aspect, x centred; y = top edge, measured on the geometry photo

key_icons: Oval dark keys in three columns, each digit large with its small letters to its right. The 1 key also shows a small voicemail icon (two rings joined along their bottoms); the 0 key shows a space symbol and '+'; the * and # keys show only their symbol.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ
